themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including agents for workflow automation and specific research functionalities.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, including code generation and analysis.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered platforms and tools specifically designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to discovery.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Deals with the creation and use of artificial user profiles or 'digital twins' for research and testing purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's capability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in quick comprehension and analysis.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Highlights AI applications that directly support and augment the design and research process, including generative design and AI-assisted ideation.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Focuses on integrated platforms and environments that offer a suite of AI capabilities for conducting research.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI technologies are changing job roles, skills requirements, and employment landscapes.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Covers the use of AI in the hiring process, including AI's impact on job seeker perceptions and recruitment outcomes.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles comparing, reviewing, and assessing the performance and usability of various AI tools for different applications.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
